overview_description.description:
Since 2014, Convox has been a leading Platform-as-a-Service provider, allowing developers to deliver applications faster, at scale. Developed by former Heroku engineers and backed by Y Combinator, Convox is built by developers, for developers. 

Offering support for all major cloud environments, including AWS, Google Cloud, Digital Ocean, and Azure, Convox is a portable and adaptable solution that fits seamlessly into your current development infrastructure regardless of the framework and programming language you use. 

Trusted by companies of all sizes, from startups to multinational enterprises, Convox is a platform that allows you to scale efficiently and will grow as you do. Get started today with a free account at Convox.com.

product.name: Convox Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS)
product.description: A cloud-based platform that automates deployment, scaling, and infrastructure management for applications across multiple cloud providers.

product.name: Convox CI/CD Workflows
product.description: Built-in continuous integration and continuous deployment workflows that automate testing, building, and deploying applications.

product.name: Convox Auto-Scaling Infrastructure
product.description: Pre-configured auto-scaling policies that automatically adjust application resources based on workload demands.

product.name: Convox Resource Management
product.description: Advanced resource management features that optimize cloud resource utilization for performance and cost efficiency.

product.name: Convox Security Features
product.description: Built-in security protocols including automated updates, network isolation, encryption, and role-based access control for applications.

product.name: Convox Framework Support for Django
product.description: A deployment and scaling solution tailored for Django applications, automating environment management and database provisioning.
